content.title: What Movies Have Won the Most Oscars? | Top Winners, Years, Categories, & Academy Awards
content.text: A biblical epic, a doomed ocean liner, and an adaptation of a classic fantasy novel—what do these have in common? All three hold the record for most Academy Award wins. In 1960 Ben-Hur (1959) won a record-setting 11 Oscars. It was later joined by Titanic (1997) and The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King (2003). How do other films compare? Read on for a list of movies that have won the most Academy Awards.(What films have the most Oscar nominations?
